The Hairy Dog is an awesome rock/metal bar in our home city. Baby Plat(inum) is a gross strip club in our home city.

Want to help cure patients of these mysterious illnesses? Then you’ll want to get your hands on A Cure For What Ails You! 

Kickstarter ends on October 31st so get involved and back now to get your hands on your own copy! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/doccheetum/a-cure-for-what-ails-you

Informed by real history & folklore, A Cure For What Ails You explores the practices, beliefs, and appalling realities of historical medicine.
